notes: Single-file rips are albums now: a .cue sheet beside the FLAC (or a CUESHEET block inside it) becomes a real tracklist, played gapless. Pull the crate up by its lip for the whole wall of sleeves. And every sleeve turns over — with no back scan, platter prints one from the cover and the tracklist.

win.notes: Rebuilt on tinyjs 0.30.0: networking fixes (hosts the runtime's fetch couldn't reach), removable event listeners, and all 0.30.0 launcher fixes.

linux.notes: Linux: cover art restored (sips is macOS-only) and the whole ritual — music, crackle bed, run-out thump — moved off Web Audio so it plays clean.
